ambient_events: A ferrous rivulet finds a new path across the wash and stains it in seconds.
The rust-red delta glistens, and the air above it tastes of blood you didn't shed.
description: A wash where iron-rich runoff braids across the flat in rust-red rivulets, staining a delta that spreads a little wider each year. Drinking it kills you slowly; standing in it, only slightly faster.
name: Ferrous Wash
